finding.evidence: if 0.0 <= dt <= max_age_s: new_overload_duration = old + dt else: new_overload_duration = old; last updated to received_at in both branches
finding.fix: Preserve duration but never credit unknown/failed/stale intervals: clear last_overload_time on any non-credited gap and require communication_failed/stale/unhealthy to invalidate timing; only add dt when interval was continuously fresh-valid.

findings.parentRationale: The fresh first post-gap sample correctly starts a new observed interval. Clearing its newly valid timestamp would omit subsequently observed unsafe time. The separate known communication-gap bug is accepted below.

finding.evidence: latches CommunicationFailure but never touches _protection_states; next receive dt spans the known failure gap and credits it if <= feedback_max_age_s
finding.fix: On communication_failed (and on stale/unhealthy housekeeping) preserve overload_duration/recovery but clear last_overload_time_s/last_recovery_time_s so the failed interval cannot be added to dwell.

findings.parentRationale: Parent thermal-history helper reproduces actual communication failure interval credit; fresh Luna correction assigned.

finding.evidence: self._protection_states = [JointProtectionState() for _ in specs] on every successful check; parent test_stop_check_cannot_erase shows non-fault Check discards .0625s overload history
finding.fix: Do not reset overload_duration on successful non-fault Check; only reset after acknowledged full recovery dwell completes, otherwise retain confirmed unsafe time.

findings.parentRationale: Parent helper reproduces loss of confirmed overload history on successful nonfault Check with still-overloaded telemetry; assigned.

finding.evidence: reset_recovery keeps last_overload_time_s; used by begin_check and claim_owner, so stop/check/takeover gap dt is credited when <= max_age_s
finding.fix: Clear both last_* timestamps on any check/claim/stop/disconnect timing reset while retaining overload_duration_s; only durations survive gaps, never gap credit.

findings.parentRationale: Parent authority-gap helper independently reproduced both initial Check and takeover gap credit. Correct the lifecycle caller transitions without erasing duration or discarding a fresh post-Check anchor.

finding.evidence: dt = received_at - last_overload_time_s; new = old + dt with binary floats; parent exact-dwell .30000000000000004 trips on .4-.1 and 30.2-30.0 recovery passes/fails on decimal times
finding.fix: Use exact rational authority (Fraction of finite floats, as C09-C13) for dt accumulation and >= dwell comparisons, with finite bounded clamping; do not decide trip/clear on rounded float sum.

findings.parentRationale: Exact Fraction parent helper establishes actual premature overload fault from rounded elapsed authority; assigned.

finding.evidence: same float new_recovery_duration = old + dt; parent recovery_before_exact_dwell clears fault early on rounded time
finding.fix: Apply same exact Fraction + bounded logic to recovery_duration_s and checked() dwell gate.

findings.parentRationale: Exact Fraction parent helper establishes premature fault recovery; assigned. Old decimal equality fixtures must also respect exact accepted clock values.

finding.evidence: loop -1e308,0.0,1e308 with max_age 1e308 yields inf overload_duration_s and recovery_duration_s
finding.fix: Bound timers to finite values, fail closed on overflow (clamp/saturate, validate isfinite, never store inf/nan).

findings.parentRationale: Both parent finite-dwell methods fail for finite accepted endpoints. Exact bounded duration records assigned.

finding.evidence: effort_limit=existing.effort_limit or effort_limit or continuous_effort_limit; continuous trip sets peak flag, breaking test_continuous_exact_dwell assertFalse(effort_limit)
finding.fix: Keep flags distinct: effort_limit only for peak >max_effort_nm, continuous_effort_limit only for dwell trip; preserve union without merging.

findings.parentRationale: The selected parent contract explicitly preserves effort_limit as aggregate effort cause with continuous_effort_limit as additional attribution. Correct the conflicting fixture and documentation, not the selected runtime cause union.

finding.evidence: is_overload credits even when status unhealthy/mode!=0/errors set; recovery candidate checks health but overload path ignores it
finding.fix: Do not credit overload dwell on unhealthy/timeout/mode-violation packets; invalidate last_overload_time on such packets while preserving duration.

findings.parentRationale: Mode1 is valid moving telemetry and must contribute measured overload time. Motor warnings/errors/watchdog status are health faults on structurally valid received telemetry, not proof of missing measurement. Recovery already rejects unhealthy data; known communication failure interval is separately fixed.

finding.evidence: stale latch does not invalidate _protection_states timing, so next receive after stale gap credits the stale interval
finding.fix: On stale/missing observation, clear last_overload/last_recovery timing (preserve durations) consistent with failed-observation rule.

findings.parentRationale: Under the retained monotonic clock contract, a stale housekeeping observation implies the next receive interval exceeds max age and the transition already refuses gap credit. No additional actual miscredit is reproduced. An explicit gap marker may clarify the same transition but is not an independent runtime defect.

finding.evidence: dec = core.receive(...59.9...); assertFalse(dec.accepted) but core._now raises ValueError: clock regressed
finding.fix: Align test with C07-C13 clock contract (raise on regress/nonfinite) instead of expecting Decision rejection; do not swallow clock errors as Decisions.

findings.parentRationale: Actual focused check error proves mismatch with established ValueError clock contract. Correct fixture; do not swallow clock errors.

finding.evidence: submit in FAULT expects FAULT_LATCHED but gets INVALID_STATE; submit allowed only in ARMED/MOVING so state check precedes latch check
finding.fix: Correct test expectation to INVALID_STATE (or drive to ARMED first); preserve lifecycle-ordering contract.

findings.parentRationale: Actual focused failure proves existing invalid-state decision priority. Correct fixture; keep latched cause and no rearm assertions.

finding.evidence: assertIs(snap.state, State.CHECKED) but State has no CHECKED (READY expected); plus 20.1/20.299/30.0/30.2 decimal times assume decimal-exact dwell
finding.fix: Fix enum to READY and use binary-exact clock steps or exact-Fraction assertions; do not require decimal-exact float equality for dwell gates.

findings.parentRationale: READY enum and binary-exact boundary fixture corrections assigned; immutable exact premature-recovery regression retained.
